elements.label: Figure 5.9
elements.title: White Noise. White noise is a type of random noise. The mean is constantly near zero. Variance is pretty constant everywhere in the series, close to a value of 1. There are no observable patterns that repeat.

details.values: Values fluctuate randomly around zero, mostly between -3 and 3, with no visible pattern or trend.

elements.summary: This line chart shows a time series of white noise, illustrating random fluctuations with a mean near zero and roughly constant variance around 1, with no repeating patterns.
